lg-0: The two “Y” shapes in the logo flow into one another, and their colours shift gently from one to the other. Like Yin and Yang, this blend shows that two halves which seem to be opposites in fact complete each other.
lg-1: For me, these two halves are the two perspectives of Eastern and Western medicine. Western medicine rests on anatomy, measurable findings and scientific evidence; it clarifies the diagnosis and tests what really works. Eastern medicine sees the person as a whole, treating body, breath, mind and the rhythm of life as inseparable.
lg-2: In my approach to treatment, I bring these two perspectives together. I look at your pain not only as a problem of a single joint or muscle, but alongside your sleep, your stress, your movement habits and your daily life. I complement manual therapy and exercise tailored to you with breathing, relaxation and mind-focused work.
lg-3: The compass for this holistic journey is science. I use a traditional approach only as far as it is safe and supported by evidence, and I tell you openly what is proven and what is still being researched. My aim is to bring the best of both worlds together in a single plan for you.
